job.title: Onsite Services Manager
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC
Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. We offer more than 2 million products and have over 80 years of experience across dozens of industries. We aim to execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise for all our stakeholders, including our associates.

Requisition ID :21678
Employment Type :Full Time
Job Category :Customer Service/Support
Work Location :Richmond, VA


BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:
TheOn-Site Service Manageris responsible for leading a team of Solution Service Representatives and On-Site Service Representatives across three service levels. This role ensures exceptional customer experience by overseeing the performance, profitability, and operational excellence of assigned customer locations. The manager collaborates closely with Field Sales, National Accounts, and Business Development to align strategy and execution, particularly for customers utilizing VMI, vending, and complex on-site solutions.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of service representatives, including recruiting, mentoring, and performance management.
  • Drive customer satisfaction and retention through strategic leadership and operational excellence.
  • Manage the performance and profitability of assigned customer locations, ensuring revenue and margin goals are met.
  • Support training in inventory management practices including break/fix, 6S, inventory optimization, and order management.
  • Guide customer service and order management development, including AS400 proficiency, SPA maintenance, and cross/up-selling.
  • Participate in Customer Improvement Reviews and strategic customer meetings.
  • Create and audit Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and daily schedules for each on-site location.
  • Evaluate and adjust service frequency and resource allocation to optimize capacity and customer experience.
  • Collaborate with the Routing Administration Team to manage headcount and service schedules.
  • Maintain monthly communication with client site champions and conduct monthly site visits.
  • Coordinate with internal departments and MSC resources to support customer projects and initiatives.
  • Partner with Account Sales Owners to identify and execute spend expansion opportunities.
  • Lead special projects related to the On-Site strategy, including Integrated Partner programs.
  • Ensure 100% compliance with MSC and customer safety protocols.
  • Audit associate timekeeping and expense reporting for policy compliance.
  • Hold team members accountable for performance, in consultation with Human Resources.
  • Manage departmental expenses to meet budget targets.
  • Conduct quarterly field evaluations of customer solutions and direct reports.
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree or a minimum of eight years of equivalent experience required.
  • At least two years of progressive growth in job responsibilities required.
  • Minimum of three years of experience or combination of the following is required: supervisory/managerial, project management or experience in a professional sourcing role.
  • Minimum four years of experience in customer service, sales, or inventory management solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong leadership, strategic thinking, and customer service orientation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • General knowledge of MRO sourcing and market participants.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Industrial or manufacturing segment experience preferred
  • Experience with crib management and procurement software is a plus.

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license may be required.
  • Position requires up to 50% of travel
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks (walking, bending, standing for long periods).
  • Willingness to comply with customer safety and PPE protocols.
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”)


Compensation starting at $83,706 - $111,576 per year depending on candidate location and experience.

The salary range represented is based on similar roles in comparable industries, and the cost of labor in respective cities. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's relevant experience, education requirements and peer pay equity. The Company reserves the right to modify the range as market conditions change.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this position at this time.

This job posting will remain open for a minimum of 3 business days from the original posting date or longer as needed to fill the position.

WHY MSC?
People. Collaboration. Insight. That's how you build something that works. Built on a foundation of trust, MSC works side by side with our customers to help them drive business results. With more than one million product offerings and 80+ years of experience across industries, MSC strives to help our customers achieve greater productivity, profitability, and growth through inventory management and other innovative supply chain solutions. We care about our associates and have programs in place to help our 6,500+ team members achieve their potential.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU
Our associates are our top priority and investing in their well-being is one way we execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise. Alongside competitive pay, we have a comprehensive benefits program to support you and your family's health, well-being and financial future. We offer dynamic healthcare plans, generous 401K and stock purchasing programs, tuition reimbursement opportunities, and paid time away for holidays, vacations, and illness. Visit our page for a better look at our extensive benefits: Your Future Benefits.

You will also have the opportunity to join our Associate Inclusion Circles: Women, Pride, Black, Generational, Veterans, HOLA, and Able. These circles are open to all associates and are designed to promote awareness, collaboration, and respect.

job.title: LTL Warehouse Associate VC 3:00pm-11:30pm
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. We offer more than 2 million products and have over 80 years of experience across dozens of industries. We aim to execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise for all our stakeholders, including our associates.

Requisition ID :21710

Employment Type :Full Time

Job Category :Warehouse/Distribution

Work Location :Atlanta, GA (Whse)

LTL- Large Pack- Heavy Lifting

Verifier/Checker - Monday - Friday - 3:00 pm - 11:30 pm

MSC is growing—and going—strong. We seek a team player who thrives in a fast-moving environment to perform daily receiving tasks, inspect shipments and verify correct items and quantities.

HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE

You will have a hands-on role in our warehouse to ensure delivery of our vast product line to our valued customers.

  • Verify products and match packing slips to P.O. using item and vendor numbers, descriptions, and quantity through visual inspections, counting, reference manuals or measuring instruments.
  • Inspect boxes for damage or improper packaging, and perform research to resolve item or purchase discrepancies.
  • Create and apply bar code labels using item numbers or purchase orders, and scan labels into warehouse computer system.
  • Handle all incoming inter-warehouse transfers.
  • Operate basic powered equipment (pallet jack, forklift); load, unload and move product by hand or skid; and move totes/skids for re-use.
  • Stage product and form/seal boxes for put-away bins, overstock and racks.
  • Train cross-functionally in other departments and functions in order to support business requirements.
  • Follow safety guidelines at all times, meet specified productivity and quality expectations, and participate in Work Clean program.

WHAT IT TAKES

The motivated individual we seek should have these qualifications.

  • Basic computer skills
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Valid state driver's license, in some instances
  • Willingness to work overtime to meet customer's needs
  • Internal certification to drive powered equipment within specified time requirements
  • Internal certification to pick DOT-regulated items, if required
  • Physical demands to successfully perform essential job functions (reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities): standing, walking, lifting materials up to 75 pounds (individual or team), carrying, pushing, pulling, climbing stairs, climbing using legs and arms, balancing, stooping, kneeling, repeated bends, reaching high and low, repetitive twisting or pressure involving wrist and hands, hearing, seeing (depth perception and peripheral vision), mental coordination, mental alertness for entire shift, ability to wear personal protective equipment as required, and ability to operate at heights up to 50 feet

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

A career at MSC includes generous benefits, rewards and recognition.

  • Training and growth opportunities
  • Weekends off
  • Paid time off including holidays
  • Incentive bonuses and shift differential
  • Medical, dental, vision, and company-matched 401(k)

Compensation starting at $20.00/hr depending on candidate location and experience.

The salary range represented is based on similar roles in comparable industries, and the cost of labor in respective cities. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's relevant experience, education requirements and peer pay equity. The Company reserves the right to modify the range as market conditions change.

This job posting will remain open for a minimum of 3 business days from the original posting date or longer as needed to fill the position.

job.title: Strategic Account Leader
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. We offer more than 2 million products and have over 80 years of experience across dozens of industries. We aim to execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise for all our stakeholders, including our associates.

Requisition ID : 21626

Employment Type : Full Time

Job Category : Sales

Work Location : Supporting Cincinnati, OH, KY, and WV


BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Strategic Accounts Leader is responsible for leading the management and retention of selecting key accounts overseeing teams with portfolios greater than $250K in potential revenue, ensuring profitable growth through customer analysis, strategic account planning, and value realization. This role directs efforts to maximize account penetration and long-term retention by overseeing the delivery of measurable value through cost savings initiatives, continuous improvement reviews (CIRs), and solution optimization. The Leader builds and sustains trusted executive-level relationships with cross-functional leaders in Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Engineering, while guiding disciplined engagement at the site level to strengthen adoption and results. In addition, this leader partners closely with the Business Development team on late-stage opportunities to support deal closure, oversee customer onboarding, and position MSC's solutions as a long-term competitive advantage.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee management and retention of key account portfolios exceeding $250K in potential revenue, ensuring profitable growth and long-term customer success.
  • Guide the development and execution of strategic account plans, ensuring alignment with business objectives and opportunities for deeper account penetration.
  • Monitor account health and retention risks, directing interventions and supporting teams in safeguarding customer satisfaction.
  • Lead negotiation and renewal strategies for underperforming or at-risk accounts to optimize profitability and value realization.
  • Ensure delivery of measurable cost savings initiatives, overseeing customer assessments, solution optimization, and documented profitability
  • Direct Continuous Improvement Reviews (CIRs) with senior stakeholders to showcase delivered value and identify new growth opportunities.
  • Foster trusted relationships with internal and external executives across Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Engineering, serving as an escalation point when needed.
  • Collaborate with Business Development leadership on late-stage opportunities, providing oversight to secure deal closure and strategic positioning.
  • Oversee customer onboarding processes, ensuring teams deliver on commitments and drive solution adoption.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Strategic Development Consultants, setting clear performance expectations and providing regular feedback.
  • Align team resources to customer priorities while building capability through best practices in analysis, negotiation, and solution positioning, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent experience required.
  • Minimum of 7 years of demonstrated sales and marketing success, including at least 2 years in industrial, manufacturing, or distribution sales.
  • Proven success in leading high-performing teams to drive profitable solution sales and consistently surpass sales objectives.
  • Demonstrated excellence in leading negotiations, influencing at multiple organizational levels, and building senior-level customer relationships.
  • Ability to interpret customer financial statements and translate insights into strategic guidance, enabling teams to craft solution recommendations that drive profitability and long-term growth.
  • Solid project management skills with a solid history of accountability, measurable results and cross functional execution.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Salesforce.com (CRM).
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize data from multiple systems and guide teams in developing effective, data-driven solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop and deliver impactful executive level presentations.
  • Proven success collaborating cross-functionally (e.g., Marketing, Product Management, Finance) and with leaders holding competing priorities.
  • High attention to detail with strong follow-through and the ability to adapt quickly to changing market and business conditions.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to build and lead teams that perform effectively in both collaborative and independent work environments.
  • Skilled at fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-focused execution.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Industrial or manufacturing segment experience preferred

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license may be required.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks (walking, bending, standing for long periods).
  • Willingness to comply with customer safety and PPE protocols.
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”)

*INDICATES ESSENTIAL DUTIES

To perform this job successfully an associate must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of knowledge, experience level and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Key Accounts Executive is responsible for driving sales growth by expanding relationships with existing customers and identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities within key account locations. Managing portfolios with potential revenues ranging from $25K to $250K, the role emphasizes exceptional account management, collaboration, and execution of strategic sales strategies to acquire, develop, and retain clients in designated territories. Responsibilities include expanding sales through new account acquisition, deepening product penetration with a focus on VMI accounts, and delivering on-site service and comprehensive account management to maximize customer retention and sustainable growth.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and strengthen relationships with customers at both functional and executive levels to ensure retention, satisfaction, and alignment with current and future needs.
  • Develop and execute strategies to deepen penetration within accounts, expand revenue opportunities, and achieve sales and retention targets.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by delivering tailored, value-driven solutions that address customer priorities.
  • Lead the implementation of major company programs and initiatives within assigned accounts.
  • Process orders, scan and verify incoming shipments, stock inventory, and manage returns to ensure accuracy and smooth daily operations.
  • Leverage CRM and account management systems to track sales activity, analyze trends, and ensure accurate forecasting and reporting.
  • Partner with internal teams to deliver operational excellence and exceed customer expectations through strong service orientation and follow-up.
  • Drive the setup and optimization of vending and VMI services at new or existing account locations.
  • Collaborate with sales management to design competitive pricing strategies for non-contract customers.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to provide customers with forward-looking solutions.
  • Prepare and submit timely, accurate sales reports that ensure alignment with management expectations.
  • Secures and submits customer orders for processing utilizing ordering technology.
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability that reflects company values.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to support broader organizational goals.

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • High school diploma or GED required; 2–4 year college degree preferred.
  • 2–3 years of outside direct sales/service experience preferred but not required.
  • Industry experience (e.g., fasteners, chemicals, industrial maintenance supplies, electrical, food processing, manufacturing) preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to read and analyze technical materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve problems, develop action plans, and drive results.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, listening, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email; able to adapt to PC-based order systems and handheld scanning devices.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and basic math skills.
  • High degree of integrity and ability to build long-term customer relationships.
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and insurance as required by state law.
  • Ability to work from a home office with personal computer and internet access.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Industrial or manufacturing segment experience preferred

Other Requirements:

  • Capable of driving up to several hours per day to customer location(s) within an assigned territory or region is required
  • Job requires visitation of customer sites, which have varying environments/conditions, layouts, and accessibility.

  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to read and analyze technical materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve problems, develop action plans, and drive results.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, listening, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email; able to adapt to PC-based order systems and handheld scanning devices.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and basic math skills.
  • High degree of integrity and ability to build long-term customer relationships.
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and insurance as required by state law.
  • Ability to work from a home office with personal computer and internet access.

  • Industrial or manufacturing segment experience preferred

  • Job requires visitation of customer sites, which have varying environments/conditions, layouts, and accessibility.

job.title: Warehouse Associate - Order Processor - Monday-Friday - 8:00am-4:30pm
job.description:
Order Processor - Monday - Friday - 8:00am to 4:30pm - No Weekends!

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

Responsible for performing any combination of tasks to ensure the orderly, timely, and correct flow of materials and product for selection and shipment on the distribution center floor. Tasks may include but are not limited to retrieving and distributing material(s), inspecting materials for packaging, preparing materials for shipment or storage by placing items in appropriate areas.

DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Count and verify items against order tickets
  • Inspects/examines all material/shipments for quality issues, overages or shortages and reports findings to supervisor.
  • Participates in routing, counting and inspecting items while loading and unloading carts.
  • Selects product and processes orders accurately as instructed manually and by computerized warehouse management operating system.
  • Ensures that product staged and stored is placed in safe areas and at safe heights.

Strategic Accounts Executive is responsible for driving sales growth, managing and retaining select key account locations across portfolios exceeding $250K in potential revenue, driving profitable growth through customer analysis, strategic account planning, and value realization. This role focuses on maximizing account penetration and long-term retention by delivering measurable value through cost savings initiatives, continuous improvement reviews (CIRs), and solution optimization.   • Develop and execute strategic account plans that anticipate customer needs, align with business objectives, and drive account penetration.
  • Proactively identify churn indicators and implement interventions to safeguard retention and customer satisfaction.
  • Negotiate and renew agreements with underperforming or at-risk accounts to optimize value realization and profitability.
  • Deliver measurable cost savings initiatives and demonstrate profitability through regular customer assessments and solution optimization.
  • Conduct Continuous Improvement Reviews (CIRs) with senior stakeholders to showcase value delivered and identify new opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted internal and external relationships with leaders in Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Engineering.
  • Ensure seamless onboarding of new customers, coordinating with internal teams to deliver commitments and adoption.
  • Engage with site-level contacts to strengthen solution adoption and ensure consistent execution of account strategies.
  • Maintain disciplined use of CRM tools and reporting standards to ensure accuracy in forecasting and account visibility.
  • Act as a strategic advisor by leveraging market insights, benchmarking, and industry trends to educate customers and strengthen partnerships.
  • Analyze customer data and trends to recommend process improvements that reduce costs and increase efficiency.
  • Present financial and operational insights to customer executives, linking MSC's solutions to measurable business outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent experience required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of demonstrated sales and marketing success, including at least 2 years in industrial, manufacturing, or distribution sales.
  • Proven track record of selling profitable solutions and services, consistently meeting or exceeding sales plans.
  • Demonstrated excellence in sales, negotiation, relationship building, and closing, with the ability to influence at multiple organizational levels.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply insights from customer financial statements to support solution recommendations.
  • Strong project management skills with a solid history of accountability and results.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Salesforce.com (CRM).
  • Ability to gather, analyze, and synthesize data from multiple systems to recommend solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop and deliver impactful presentations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with proven success collaborating cross-functionally (e.g., Marketing, Product Management, Finance) and with leaders holding competing priorities.
  • High attention to detail, follow-through, and ability to adapt quickly to changing business needs and market conditions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound, timely decisions.
  • Self-motivated and adaptable, able to perform effectively in both independent and team environments.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Industrial or manufacturing segment experience preferred

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license may be required.
  • Capable of driving up to several hours per day to customer location(s) within an assigned territory or region is required

job.title: Buyer - OEM
job.description:
BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The MSC OEM Team is dedicated to developing real production fastener solutions for our customers by supporting them with custom engineering, valuable product insight, and a global portfolio of suppliers. The position will serve to determine and correctly place purchase orders. This role requires attention to detail and documentation that includes accurate amounts of product as well as accurate delivery times, along with correct permissions and all of which must be in accordance with the Purchasing Guidelines outlined by the MSC OEM Purchasing Department.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Focused, Be Curious and Open Minded, Passionate Team Player, Say/Do, Get to Yes!
  • Reviews published PORG (Purchase Order Requirements/Generation) report to analyze inventory levels and usage trends and places purchase orders for 10K+ SKUs across 50+ suppliers.
  • Executes the Open PO report to determine items that need to have the delivery date(s) updated
  • Reviews and validates procurement/distribution plans (based on business rules, lead times, forecasts, sales orders, safety stock requirements, etc.) and then executes the procurement process of placing purchase orders to the OEM Distribution Centers for assigned Suppliers.
  • Responsible for managing inventory levels for assigned Suppliers / product lines and developing / implementing plans as needed to achieve inventory turns goals.
  • Establishes and monitors inventory levels against forecasts and usage trends, validates forecasts, and achieves targeted company service level goals for assigned Suppliers.
  • Develops and implements plans to satisfy demand requirements while balancing inventories against key performance metrics (e.g. inventory dollars, turns, obsolescence and customer service).
  • Performs order process analysis to optimize purchase order cycles and operating costs. Assesses purchasing options, calculate total into stock costs and analyzing cost reduction opportunities to optimize total spend by optimizing loads via combining various products onto a single order, pre-ordering as needed to reduce costs, surveying alternative Suppliers for cost reductions, etc.
  • Maintains relationships with Suppliers and drives supply chain compliance.
  • Expedites and devises alternative solutions (identify fill-in buy opportunities and substitute product) to resolve backorders in a timely manner.
  • Collaborates with key cross functional supply chain partners (Category Management, Distribution Centers, Accounting, etc.) to pro-actively identify supply chain issues affecting cost and service to customers.
  • Ensures timeliness of product delivery and the quality of the product delivered through frequent interaction with Suppliers.
  • Creates Secondary Processes to modify parts per specifications and Production Orders to build kits and assemblies.
  • Learns to identify product database errors and follows up to ensure correction.
  • Works on process improvement teams and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Coordinates with Suppliers, Category and Sourcing Managers to identify and reconcile gaps and supply shortages, providing an early warning system for issue identification.
  • Review and process invoice discrepancies and coordinate with A/P & Category to reconcile supplier payments.
  • Review supplier performance, negotiate pricing levels, and implement new Suppliers as needed in coordination/support of the Purchasing, Sourcing and Category teams.
  • Identify and assist in disposition of slow and obsolete inventory.
  • Ensures all established costs, quality, and delivery commitments are met.
  • Enforce quality standards, inventory levels, and purchasing procedures.
  • Support peer Buyer's efforts toward Company goals.
  • Consistently provide best-in-class customer service to internal and external customers.
  • Position requires frequent contact outside the company with the supply base. Infrequent contact required with customers, peer organizations, and purchasing and industry groups.
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's Degree (preferably in Business, Finance, or Engineering) or two years of relevant purchasing experience required.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely and in professional manner both verbally and in writing
  • Ability to determine possible challenges and obstacles and negotiate and persuade to Get to Yes
  • Organized and detail-minded to document and stay on track with processes, including follow up with all associated parties
  • Must have a strong sense of urgency to keep a steady pulse on moving forward with projects, processes, and deadlines
  • Ability to organize competing tasks and responsibilities and accomplish goals and meet deadlines
  • Ability to analyze and develop solutions to problems

Requisition ID :21673

Employment Type :Full Time

Job Category :Sales

Work Location :Minneapolis, MN (This territory is in the heart of greater Minneapolis/St. Paul)


BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Key Accounts Executive is responsible for driving sales growth by expanding relationships with existing customers and identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities within key account locations. Managing portfolios with potential revenues ranging from $25K to $250K, the role emphasizes exceptional account management, collaboration, and execution of strategic sales strategies to acquire, develop, and retain clients in designated territories. Responsibilities include expanding sales through new account acquisition, deepening product penetration with a focus on VMI accounts, and delivering on-site service and comprehensive account management to maximize customer retention and sustainable growth.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and strengthen relationships with customers at both functional and executive levels to ensure retention, satisfaction, and alignment with current and future needs.
  • Develop and execute strategies to deepen penetration within accounts, expand revenue opportunities, and achieve sales and retention targets.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by delivering tailored, value-driven solutions that address customer priorities.
  • Lead the implementation of major company programs and initiatives within assigned accounts.
  • Process orders, scan and verify incoming shipments, stock inventory, and manage returns to ensure accuracy and smooth daily operations.
  • Leverage CRM and account management systems to track sales activity, analyze trends, and ensure accurate forecasting and reporting.
  • Partner with internal teams to deliver operational excellence and exceed customer expectations through strong service orientation and follow-up.
  • Drive the setup and optimization of vending and VMI services at new or existing account locations.
  • Collaborate with sales management to design competitive pricing strategies for non-contract customers.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to provide customers with forward-looking solutions.
  • Prepare and submit timely, accurate sales reports that ensure alignment with management expectations.
  • Secures and submits customer orders for processing utilizing ordering technology.
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability that reflects company values.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to support broader organizational goals.

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • High school diploma or GED required; 2–4 year college degree preferred.
  • 2–3 years of outside direct sales/service experience preferred but not required.
  • Industry experience (e.g., fasteners, chemicals, industrial maintenance supplies, electrical, food processing, manufacturing) preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to read and analyze technical materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve problems, develop action plans, and drive results.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, listening, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email; able to adapt to PC-based order systems and handheld scanning devices.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and basic math skills.
  • High degree of integrity and ability to build long-term customer relationships.
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and insurance as required by state law.
  • Ability to work from a home office with personal computer and internet access.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Industrial or manufacturing segment experience preferred

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license may be required.
  • Capable of driving up to several hours per day to customer location(s) within an assigned territory or region is required
  • Job requires visitation of customer sites, which have varying environments/conditions, layouts, and accessibility.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks (walking, bending, standing for long periods).
  • Willingness to comply with customer safety and PPE protocols.

Vertical Market Group – Cross Reference & Sourcing Supervisor

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Vertical Markets Group (VMG) Cross Reference & Sourcing Supervisor provides leadership and oversight for the Cross Reference and Sourcing team supporting Public Sector and Commercial customer opportunities. This role is responsible for guiding the team in researching, validating, and delivering compliant product cross-references and sourcing solutions for customer-specific part number requirements, helping the sales team secure business. In addition to daily team oversight, the Supervisor provides coaching, prioritizes work, manages workloads, offers process guidance, and monitors productivity and quality metrics to ensure customer requirements are met efficiently and accurately. The Supervisor will also support continuous improvement efforts by identifying process gaps, promoting documentation standards, improving sourcing and cross-reference workflows, and driving efficiencies that enhance accuracy, compliance, customer experience, and revenue growth.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manages the VMG Cross Reference & Sourcing Team to achieve performance goals related to service levels, product approvals, cross & sourcing accuracy, compliance, and profitability.
  • Provides leadership, coaching, performance management, training, and development opportunities to support associate growth, accountability, succession planning, and achievement of team objectives.
  • Oversees daily VMG Cross Reference & Sourcing operations, including workload management, service levels, and aging requests, to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant support of customer, RFQ, and bid requirements.
  • Analyzes operational performance, identifies improvement opportunities, and drives process and system enhancements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and service effectiveness.
  • Work with managers to develop team metrics, training plans, and process improvements to strengthen performance, improve accuracy, and support continuous operational efficiency.
  • Develops and maintains standard operating procedures, job aids, and documentation while promoting knowledge sharing and standard work practices to support quality, consistency, and scalability.
  • Understands key compliance and contracting issues associated with government segment and incorporates into business planning and decision making.
  • Partners with Sales, suppliers, and key business stakeholders to align priorities, resolve complex sourcing and compliance issues, remove operational barriers, and support customer commitments.
  • Supports supplier and category engagement for complex sourcing needs, phase-outs, replacement items, private label opportunities, and profit improvement initiatives.
  • Reviews team output for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with customer requirements, contract terms, and compliance standards.

  • Serves as a working supervisor when required by business needs, directly supporting cross-reference, sourcing, RFQ, bid, or customer-related activities to ensure service commitments are met.
  • Ensures that direct reports follow all MSC policy and procedure documented in the Associate handbook.
  • Performs all duties inherent in the role of an MSC Supervisor including hiring, termination, review and development of associates.
  • Drives the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required.

QUALIFICATIONS
What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Supply Chain, Operations, or (5) years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree, is required.
  • Minimum of three years of experience in sourcing, product cross-referencing, customer support, operations, sales support, procurement, or a related business function, is required.
  • Working knowledge of NSNs, CAGE codes, OEM documentation, CAD drawings, and technical specifications.
  • Advanced knowledge of MRO (Maintenance, Repair and Operations), industrial, safety, janitorial, facilities, or military-related products.
  • Proficient in business systems, reporting tools, Microsoft Office applications, and workflow or productivity platforms, is required.
  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, reporting, and data analysis
  • Strong understanding of product data, item specifications, sourcing channels, supplier capabilities, and customer-specific part number matching.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage workload priorities, monitor performance metrics, and support timely completion of business-critical requests.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to resolve complex sourcing, compliance, and customer-related issues.
  • Ability to coach, develop, and provide feedback to associates while supporting accountability and team performance.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to partner effectively with Sales, Procurement, suppliers, management, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to maintain accurate documentation and standard work practices.
  • Ability to support process improvements, system enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives that improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Prior leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting RFQs, bids, government contracts, Public Sector customers, or compliance-driven customer requirements preferred.
  • Experienced user of AS400, SalesForce, SAP, reporting applications, is preferred.
  • Experience with Smartsheet, Power BI, dashboards, or workflow tracking tools, is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead process improvement, automation, or system enhancement initiatives, is preferred.
  • Experience developing standard work, training materials, SOPs, or team reference guides, is preferred.
  • Strong supplier relationship management and negotiation skills., is preferred.
  • Experience supporting high-volume RFQ, bid, or quote environments with tight deadlines, is preferred.
  • Understanding of contract compliance, risk mitigation, auditing, and documentation controls, is preferred.

Other Requirements:

  • The ability to travel up to 10-20% of the time is required.

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Vertical Markets Group (VMG) Cross Reference & Sourcing Specialist provides end-to-end support for VMG- Public Sector and Commercial customer opportunities that require matching customer-specific part numbers. In this role, the Specialist will be responsible for analyzing item specifications, identifying equivalent MSC products, sourcing non-stock and specialized items, and ensuring product compatibility and compliance that meet federal, state, and local government requirements. This position plays a critical role in supporting accurate item matching, regulatory compliance, dependable sourcing, and timely RFQ and bid submissions, enabling the sales team to confidently price and secure business. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound judgment to deliver effective cross-reference and sourcing support. The Specialist will foster collaboration across sales, procurement, suppliers, and other key stakeholders, while maintaining detailed documentation and contributing to continuous process improvements that enhance efficiency, accuracy, and revenue growth.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Cross Referencing & Item Matching


  • Cross-reference part numbers, NSNs, UPCs, manufacturer data, and competitor information using internal systems and external databases to match products to MSC part numbers.

  • Research, validate, and identify equivalent or substitute products that meet government specifications, standards, and contract requirements.

  • Maintain accurate cross-reference data and validate product compatibility, compliance, and replacement options for obsolete or end-of-life parts across ERP, contract management, and government pricing systems.

Specialized Sourcing


  • Source non-stock, discontinued, and hard-to-find items through approved suppliers while ensuring alignment with customer requirements, bid specifications, and federal compliance standards.

  • Identify and qualify suppliers that meet government contract requirements, including eligibility, registration, and documentation standards. (e.g., SAM registration, CAGE codes)

  • Identify and qualify approved suppliers capable of supporting government contracts and compliance requirements. (e.g., FAR, DFARS, ITAR, BAA, and TAA requirements)

  • Partner with suppliers to secure pricing, lead times, availability, and alternative product solutions while addressing supply chain disruptions and contract changes.

Program Support


  • Manage and track program add requests, ensuring timely coordination from intake through submission

  • Coordinate with sourcing and operational teams to support contract additions, maintain status updates, and communicate project progress.

  • Validate source and cross-reference data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with government contract requirements.

  • Maintain contract tracking tools and reporting, including item tracker, customer output analysis support, and comp data review to support revenue growth opportunities.


  • Compliance, Documentation & Audit Support

  • Document cross-reference and sourcing decisions to support traceability and audit readiness.

  • Maintain complete and accurate records of cross-referenced items, sourcing decisions, and supplier communications to support documentation standards and business continuity.

  • Review cross-reference and sourcing product data for completeness, accuracy, and alignment with government purchasing regulations, contract terms, and internal standards.

  • Contribute to process improvements that strengthen controls, reduce errors, and support operational effectiveness.


  • Collaboration & Communication

  • Serve as the primary Cross & Source liaison across Sales and internal teams during bid development, facilitating meetings and ensuring all approvals are secured to move forward.

  • Partner with Sales and cross-functional teams to align sourcing strategies with customer needs, timelines, and business priorities.

  • Foster strong supplier engagement to drive responsiveness, competitive pricing, and reliable supply.

  • Escalate critical sourcing issues in a timely manner to minimize impact to customer requirements

  • Provide clear and consistent updates to stakeholders on project status, sourcing progress, and issue resolution.


  • Process Improvement

  • Evaluate cross-referencing and sourcing workflows to identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements.

  • Contribute to SOP development, knowledge base content, and training materials.

  • Support the rollout and adoption of new tools, systems, and process enhancements.

  • Evaluate recurring issues, recommend improvements, and assist to implement corrective actions to reduce errors and rework.


  • Submission & Tracking

  • Collaborate with team members to ensure alignment on submission priorities and deadlines.

  • Maintain organized tracking of bid amendments, revisions, and resubmissions.

  • Ensure all Cross & Source activities are completed within established deadlines and submission requirements.

  • Maintain accurate records of bid activity, including submission details, outcomes, and key timelines.


  • Continuous Learning & Development

  • Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning by utilizing monthly allocated time to enhance product knowledge.

  • Leverage newly acquired knowledge to strengthen product, supplier, and systems knowledge, supporting sound decisions and evolving business needs.

  • Remain adaptable to changing tools, systems, and business priorities through ongoing learning and skill development.

  • Share knowledge and best practices while providing coaching and mentorship to VMG Cross Reference & Sourcing team members to support collaboration and continuous improvement.

  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.

  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

    What You Need:

  • Associate's degree in business or related field, or equivalent work experience, is required.

  • A minimum of (3) years of Industrial industry experience, is required.

  • A minimum of (3) years in MRO experience in sales, customer care, sourcing, product support or equivalent work experience in technical field (I.E. Production Maintenance, Electrical, Safety, Industrial Maintenance, Metal Working), is required.

  • In-depth working knowledge of MRO (Maintenance, Repair and Operations) industrial products, item data, sourcing channels, and military products, is required.

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to support independent decision making is required.

  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when identifying, sourcing, and crossing products is required.

  • Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to plan, expedite, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, is required.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and listening skills, with strong attention to detail to quickly resolve issues and identify root causes, is required.

The position of Band Weld Operator includes welding and fabrication according to dimensional requirements, as well as other general warehouse functions.

DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

Welding Bandsaw Blades

  • Selects correct coil stock from work order.
  • Matches tooth gullet and cuts to proper length.
  • Sets the welder to the proper specifications, welds and anneals the blade using Lenox / Ideal band welding machines.
  • Grinds the flash from the blade within specified tolerance.
  • Grit blasts the weld portion of the blade.
  • Coils blade and matches paperwork with identification tag.
  • Performs preventive maintenance on welding equipment.
  • Maintains and keeps work area clean.
  • Trouble shoots & repairs welding equipment as necessary.
  • Ensure that all supplies needed for welding department are stocked and available.

Shipping

  • Picks items from racks and carts.
  • Audits packages for accuracy.
  • Packs items using specifications.
  • Utilizes UPS WorldShip and FedEx for small package shipments
  • Prepares Bills of Lading for truck shipments.
  • Loads trucks for shipment.
  • Processes customer returns.
  • Ensure that all supplies needed for shipping department are stocked and available

Receiving

  • Unloads trucks.
  • Matches packing slips to P.O. using descriptions, vendor numbers, MSC item numbers and quantity.
  • Scans packing slips or manually receives packing slips into warehouse computer system.
  • Performs research to resolve item or purchase order discrepancies.
  • Puts away product into racks, bins or overstock.
  • Verifies products using item numbers, descriptions, and quantity

Building Maintenance

  • Assists in all housekeeping duties inside and outside facility to maintain a safe, clean workplace.

Other

  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure unity of purpose and fulfillment of MSC's mission.

Participates in special projects and performs additional duties as required.

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Process Improvement Engineer I is responsible for developing and maintaining engineered standards while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and overall operations at the Customer Fulfillment Center (CFC). This position works closely with cross-functional teams to analyze processes, conduct time studies, develop labor standards, identify bottlenecks, and implement process improvements.

The role also provides opportunities to develop skills in data analytics, SQL, AutoCAD, scripting, and other process improvement technologies.

  • Work with cross-functional teams to identify and implement effective and efficient process improvements while minimizing risk to associates and operations.

  • Develop and maintain engineered standards, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and labor reporting systems for the CFC.

  • Partner with Operations to improve labor reporting, workforce utilization, and overall performance.

  • Conduct time studies and work measurement analyses to determine optimal processes and labor standards.

  • Develop slotting optimization reports to reduce labor requirements and improve operational efficiency.

  • Create process layouts that support best practices and efficient workflow.

  • Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks.

  • Develop and document standard cost data for process improvement analysis.

  • Perform cost-benefit analyses to determine the financial feasibility of proposed process improvements.

  • Microsoft Excel

  • Experience with engineered standards development tools.

  • Ability to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:
As a Lead Engineer, Integration at MSC, you will be responsible for the design, development, and delivery of integration solutions across enterprise systems, partner platforms, and digital applications. This is a hands-on, solution-oriented role that works closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable integration designs aligned with enterprise architecture standards. You will lead the implementation of integrations using modern patterns such as APIs and event-driven messaging, while supporting the transition from legacy integration approaches. Working in partnership with the Solution Architect, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality integration solutions, leading delivery efforts, and mentoring engineering teams to support MSC’s evolving integration platform strategy.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Solution Design & Delivery

  • Design, develop, and lead the implementation of integration solutions across enterprise systems, partners, and platforms
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable, maintainable integration designs
  • Lead and participate in full lifecycle delivery (design, build, test, deploy, support)
  • Ensure solutions meet requirements for performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Own delivery of integration solutions from design through production, ensuring quality and alignment with requirements

Technical Implementation & Problem Solving

  • Build integrations using modern patterns, including APIs, event-driven messaging, and data transformation techniques
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration and data flow issues across systems
  • Apply best practices for error handling, resiliency, and data validation
  • Ensure solutions are production-ready and operationally stable

Delivery Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead small to mid-sized integration delivery efforts across internal engineers and external consultants
  • Provide technical leadership during implementation, ensuring alignment with architecture and design standards
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers and developers, promoting best practices and continuous improvement
  • Support onboarding and development of team members and delivery partners

Standards Application & Modernization

  • Implement integration solutions in alignment with established architecture patterns, standards, and guardrails
  • Contribute to reusable integration components, templates, and frameworks
  • Drive modernization efforts by transitioning legacy integrations toward scalable, API- and event-driven architectures

Platform Contribution & Operations

  • Support the stability and reliability of the integration platform through monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance
  • Ensure integrations are observable, supportable, and properly documented
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and overall platform effectiveness

Collaboration & Delivery Support

  • Collaborate with architects, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver integration capabilities
  • Support planning, estimation, and execution of integration work
  • Communicate solution design, progress, and issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC’s vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, or related discipline or equivalent experience required
  • 6+ years of experience in systems integration, software development, or a related field required
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise integration solutions in complex, multi-system environments
  • Experience leading technical delivery efforts and mentoring engineers, consultants, or technical teams
  • Strong expertise in enterprise integration patterns, APIs, event-driven architecture, and modernizing legacy integrations toward scalable, loosely coupled solutions
  • Experience with integration platforms and technologies (e.g., SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, messaging/event platforms, MFT solutions)
  • Proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript for integration development and support
  • Proficiency in Spring Boot, Bootstrap, HTMX, Node.js
  • Proficiency in CI/CD Automation, Docker Containerization, REST APIs & Microservices, GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket, Agile/Scrum Development
  • Proficiency in DevOps & Observability
  • Strong understanding of data integration, transformation, distributed systems, system-to-system communication, and relational database concepts (SQL)
  • Familiarity with modern data and integration architectures supporting real-time processing, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled business capabilities

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Demonstrates strong problem-solving skills and the ability to design and implement effective technical solutions
  • Communicates clearly with both technical and business stakeholders
  • Takes ownership of delivery outcomes and ensures high-quality results
  • Leads by example while mentoring and developing team members
  • Collaborates effectively across teams and delivery partners
  • Adapts to evolving technologies and business priorities in a fast-paced environment

Other Requirements:

  • The ability to travel up to 10% of the time is required
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”)

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and strengthen relationships with customers at both functional and executive levels to ensure retention, satisfaction, and alignment with current and future needs.
  • Develop and execute strategies to deepen penetration within accounts, expand revenue opportunities, and achieve sales and retention targets.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by delivering tailored, value-driven solutions that address customer priorities.
  • Lead the implementation of major company programs and initiatives within assigned accounts.
  • Process orders, scan and verify incoming shipments, stock inventory, and manage returns to ensure accuracy and smooth daily operations.
  • Leverage CRM and account management systems to track sales activity, analyze trends, and ensure accurate forecasting and reporting.
  • Partner with internal teams to deliver operational excellence and exceed customer expectations through strong service orientation and follow-up.
  • Drive the setup and optimization of vending and VMI services at new or existing account locations.
  • Collaborate with sales management to design competitive pricing strategies for non-contract customers.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to provide customers with forward-looking solutions.
  • Prepare and submit timely, accurate sales reports that ensure alignment with management expectations.
  • Secures and submits customer orders for processing utilizing ordering technology.
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability that reflects company values.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to support broader organizational goals.

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • High school diploma or GED required; 2–4 year college degree preferred.
  • 2–3 years of outside direct sales/service experience preferred but not required.

  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to read and analyze technical materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve problems, develop action plans, and drive results.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, listening, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email; able to adapt to PC-based order systems and handheld scanning devices.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and basic math skills.
  • High degree of integrity and ability to build long-term customer relationships.
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and insurance as required by state law.

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The primary duty of the Engineering Inside Sales Tech is to provide engineering print and documentation support to the sourcing and purchasing team from the customer prints received for the parts we are going to provide them. If necessary, in conjunction with the outside engineering sales team members coordinate reverse engineering projects with customers, OEM, and the OEM manufacturers. Work internally with the OEM functional group members to ensure our capability of providing the customers with the part(s) they are requesting and communicate any differences with all involved.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reviews customer “part to print” to ensure what they physically have matches what they have specified on their engineering documentation and/or the samples provided
  • Reconciles differences and gets approval of markups and deviations in meeting with outside sales engineer and the customer
  • Engages with the OEM Sourcing team to review and coordinate the customer print against the supplier's capability to provide parts to specification
  • Reconciles with the supplier if requested by sourcing, the differences and deviations between the customer's design print, requirements and specifications and the manufacturing print and capabilities from the supplier.
  • Assists the sourcing team to reconcile with customers and obtain approval on supplier's print
  • Reviews the customer's application against the design print, requirements and specifications
  • Reviews and request adjustment of the information from MIR, based on meetings and documented agreements with the customer, and according with the reconciled and approved documentation from customer and from supplier
  • Actively participates in part review meetings with sourcing, purchasing and QC.
  • Works jointly with AIS quality department on print readying and print reviews.
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field or equivalent experience required.
  • Minimum of five years of experience in design or application engineering or technical experience with production fasteners and OEM items
  • Knowledge of fasteners and bolted joint design.
  • Maintains a high level of confidentiality related to all duties and responsibilities, such as the proprietary information of vendors and customers.
  • Strong ability to apply applications of engineering principles and practices to solve specific problems in a timely manner.
  • Ability to document process flow and report improvements to the process or product.
  • Understands process and product testing procedures including chemical, mechanical, and dimensional.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal required.
  • Ability to deal professionally with customers, internal customers and suppliers in a polite, efficient, and responsive way required.
  • Ability to communicate technical information to non-technical users required.
  • Self-motivate, committed and enthusiastic Engineering/Technical professional, must be able to work on own initiative and without constant supervision.

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license may be required.
  • Position requires up to 20% travel
  • Flexibility in traveling across North America as directed if required

job.title: Solutions Architect, Integration
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. Requisition ID :21165

Employment Type :Full Time

Job Category :Digital/IT

Work Location :Davidson, NC (CSC)

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:
The Solutions Architect, Integration is responsible for defining, governing, and continuously improving integration as a shared enterprise platform capability across MSC. This role provides architectural leadership for the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and reliable integration solutions spanning APIs, events, file transfers, and legacy connectivity, while ensuring alignment with enterprise standards. Operating at the intersection of architecture and delivery, the role guides engineering teams, establishes integration patterns, and drives high-quality outcomes across all integration initiatives. This position is critical to enabling MSC's composable architecture, AI, and advanced analytics strategies by ensuring enterprise systems and data are connected through scalable, real-time integration capabilities.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead and govern the design and delivery of integration solutions across enterprise systems, partners, and platforms, ensuring alignment with architecture standards and business objectives
  • Provide technical direction and design oversight to engineering and delivery teams, guiding solution design, resolving complex challenges, and ensuring scalable, maintainable outcomes aligned with MSC integration standards and patterns
  • Drive end-to-end delivery across the integration lifecycle (design, build, test, deploy, support), ensuring high quality, performance, reliability, and operational stability
  • Enable AI and advanced analytics use cases by ensuring enterprise data and systems are accessible through modern integration patterns, and drive adoption of real-time, event-driven integration approaches
  • Provide mentorship to integration engineers and developers, influence technical decisions, serve as an escalation point for complex integration challenges, and drive the adoption of integration best practices and continuous improvement

Integration Architecture & Patterns

  • Define and implement standard integration patterns (API-led, event-driven, batch/file, messaging)
  • Establish reusable frameworks, templates, and accelerators to improve speed and consistency
  • Ensure solutions align to enterprise architecture and data standards
  • Evaluate and recommend integration technologies and tools
  • Design for scalability, resiliency, and future growth of the platform

Platform Ownership & Governance

  • Act as the technical steward of MSC’s Integration Platform, defining and governing standards, patterns, and architectural guardrails across all integration initiatives
  • Ensure integrations are secure, reliable, and observable by establishing requirements for monitoring, data integrity, error handling, and operational support
  • Drive consistency and adoption of integration best practices across teams, ensuring solutions are reusable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise architecture
  • Continuously evolve the integration platform by identifying opportunities to enhance capabilities, improve efficiency, and support emerging digital and data-driven needs

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with business teams, architects, and product owners to translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Work with internal and external partners to design and implement integrations
  • Support project planning, estimation, and execution
  • Communicate technical designs and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Operational Excellence & Support

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues across systems and partners
  • Ensure production stability and manage integration lifecycle support
  • Drive root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and automation for integration processes
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC’s vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience is required
  • 8+ years of experience in systems integration, software engineering, or related field
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise integration solutions
  • Experience leading technical teams or acting as a senior/lead engineer
  • Experience working in complex enterprise environments with multiple systems and data sources
  • Strong experience with enterprise integration patterns, driving modernization from legacy approaches to scalable, API- and event-driven architectures
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, service-oriented and event-driven architectures, and system-to-system interoperability
  • Proficiency in data integration, transformation, and relational database concepts, with working knowledge of SQL and data modeling
  • Proficiency in Spring Boot, Bootstrap, HTMX, Node.js, React / Angular / Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript
  • Proficiency in CI/CD Automation, Docker Containerization, REST APIs & Microservices, GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket, Agile/Scrum Development
  • Foundational knowledge of DevOps & Observability
  • Experience with modern integration platforms (e.g., SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, API Management, messaging/event platforms) and cloud environments (Azure, GCP, AWS)
  • Understanding of software development principles and scripting/programming (e.g., Java, Python) sufficient to guide design, troubleshooting, and delivery teams
  • Familiarity with AI and data fundamentals, including how data accessibility, real-time integration, and event-driven architectures support AI and advanced analytics use cases

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Demonstrates strong technical leadership by guiding teams through complex problem solving and driving sound architectural decisions
  • Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex concepts into clear and actionable outcomes
  • Takes ownership of outcomes, ensuring high-quality delivery aligned with standards, timelines, and business objectives
  • Build strong collaborative relationships across teams, partners, and stakeholders to drive alignment and shared success
  • Thinks strategically while executing pragmatically in a fast-paced and evolving environment
  • Continuously learns and adapts to new technologies, industry trends, and changing business needs

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time is required
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”)

  • High degree of integrity and ability to build long-term customer relationships.
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and insurance as required by state law.

This role focuses on maximizing account penetration and long-term retention by delivering measurable value through cost savings initiatives, continuous improvement reviews (CIRs), and solution optimization.   • Proactively identify churn indicators and implement interventions to safeguard retention and customer satisfaction.
  • Negotiate and renew agreements with underperforming or at-risk accounts to optimize value realization and profitability.
  • Deliver measurable cost savings initiatives and demonstrate profitability through regular customer assessments and solution optimization.
  • Conduct Continuous Improvement Reviews (CIRs) with senior stakeholders to showcase value delivered and identify new opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted internal and external relationships with leaders in Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Engineering.

  • Maintain disciplined use of CRM tools and reporting standards to ensure accuracy in forecasting and account visibility.
  • Act as a strategic advisor by leveraging market insights, benchmarking, and industry trends to educate customers and strengthen partnerships.

  • Present financial and operational insights to customer executives, linking MSC's solutions to measurable business outcomes.

  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply insights from customer financial statements to support solution recommendations.
  • Strong project management skills with a solid history of accountability and results.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Salesforce.com (CRM).
  • Ability to gather, analyze, and synthesize data from multiple systems to recommend solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop and deliver impactful presentations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound, timely decisions.
  • Self-motivated and adaptable, able to perform effectively in both independent and team environments.

job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co.
